scan_table_check.description:
Flags update sets that capture a change (not a delete) to a record delivered by ServiceNow: the record's package is a plugin (sys_plugins, for example com.snc.incident) or a ServiceNow store application (sys_store_app, for example sn_upgrade_mgmt), and not a scoped x_ application. Changed out-of-box records are skipped by upgrades: they no longer receive fixes and must be reviewed after every upgrade. Records of custom global applications (sys_app, whose package source is a sys_id) are not out-of-box.
Replaces the legacy check "NS: Update Set Overwrites Out-of-Box Records", which treated every package other than global and x_ as out-of-box and so also flagged custom global applications.
scan_table_check.name: SN-CFG-007: Update set changes an out-of-box record
scan_table_check.resolution_details: Avoid changing out-of-box records: extend them (for example a new Business Rule or Script Include) instead. If the change is needed, document it; the record is now skipped by upgrades and must be reviewed after every upgrade.
scan_table_check.short_description: The update set captures a change to a record delivered by a ServiceNow package.
scan_table_check.sys_name: SN-CFG-007: Update set changes an out-of-box record
